description: This file contains mock class definitions for media pipeline capabilities used in testing, including factory and capabilities mocks with mocked methods for creating media pipeline capabilities and querying supported MIME types.

classes.name: MediaPipelineCapabilitiesFactoryMock
classes.description: Mock class for IMediaPipelineCapabilitiesFactory, providing a mocked method to create media pipeline capabilities.

classes.name: MediaPipelineCapabilitiesMock
classes.description: Mock class for IMediaPipelineCapabilities, providing mocked methods to get supported MIME types and check MIME type support.

methods.name: createMediaPipelineCapabilities
methods.description: Mocked method to create a media pipeline capabilities object.

methods.name: getSupportedMimeTypes
methods.description: Mocked method to retrieve supported MIME types for a given media source type.

methods.name: isMimeTypeSupported
methods.description: Mocked method to check if a specific MIME type is supported.
